template<typename T>
T maxOf(T a, T b) {
    if (a > b) {
        return a;
    }
    return b;
}

template <typename T, typename U>
bool bothPositive(T a, U b) {
    return a > 0 && b > 0;
}

// A move constructor: "T&&" here is a reference qualifier, not a
// logical-and, and must not inflate this function's complexity.
class Buffer {
public:
    Buffer(Buffer&& other) {
        if (other.size > 0) {
            size = other.size;
        }
        other.size = 0;
    }

private:
    int size = 0;
};

// A plain function mixing a real "&&" alongside an unrelated rvalue-ref
// local declaration, so the correction must apply to the declaration only.
int mix(int a, int b) {
    int&& tmp = compute(a, b);
    if (a > 0 && b > 0) {
        return tmp;
    }
    return 0;
}

typedef int&& IntRvalueRef;
typedef void (*Callback)(int&& payload);

int afterTypedefs(int a, int b) {
    if (a > 0 && b > 0) {
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
